blocks.text: Aksar 'samandar ke jangal' kehlane wale mangroves khushki aur samandar ke milap par namak bardasht jangalat hain.

blocks.alt: Mangrove jangal ka saada labelled manzar aur saath maloomat ka card.
blocks.caption: mangrove jangal: labelled khaaka aur maloomat ka card (asal khaaka).
blocks.long_description: Kam gehre namkeen-meethe paani mein mangrove darakht, mehraab numa sahara jarhein aur seedhi saans leti jarhein. Card mein jagah (Keti Bandar aur Mirpur Sakro par Indus delta, aur Balochistan ka sahil), halaat (namkeen-meetha paani, oxygen se khaali keechar), paude (Avicennia marina, timmar, jangal ka taqreeban 95%), janwar (jhinge, kekre, mudskippers, kachhue, dolphins, flamingo, saaras, pelican) aur haalat (darya ka kam paani aur aaloodgi se khatre mein, bahali ke kaam se madad).
